split_policy: 15 dev / 5 test; test created before pipeline runs and frozen before looking at results.
filter_policy: Only the book metadata field is used. Filter is supplied before retrieval and never contains gold_unit_id or gold_page.
evidence_policy: Every evidence_quote must be an exact substring of its gold_unit_id after NFC normalization and whitespace collapse; quotes must be unique across questions.
change_policy: Do not edit test questions after seeing results. If a change is unavoidable, create benchmark v2 and report it separately.
